function.name: get_scene_status
function.description: Read the active USD stage, current environment/time, and primary RTG positions.

function.name: get_bay_inventory
function.description: Read a yard bay's container inventory and box area map: six row heights, tier occupancy, container numbers and sizes. Resolves 40 ft stacks covering 20 ft bays. Use this for questions like 'What is the box area map on 4C41 Bay?'. Returns source mode and snapshot time; does not change the scene.

function.name: get_yard_inventory_summary
function.description: Read recorded container counts and occupied bay maps for the yard or one block. Distinguishes live and simulation sources; does not change the scene.

function.name: set_environment
function.description: Set the Smart Port scene environment preset to day, night, rain, or fog.

function.name: set_time_of_day
function.description: Set the Smart Port 24-hour lighting clock. Hour must be between 0 and 24.

function.name: set_weather
function.description: Set wind speed and/or rain and fog grades in the active Smart Port scene.

function.name: move_rtg_to_bay
function.description: Move the primary RTG in the local USD scene to a yard bay, such as 1C/017.

function.name: set_rtg_axis_positions
function.description: Set one or more primary RTG axes in the local USD scene using soft limits.

function.name: preview_yard_to_ship_transfer
function.description: Read-only plan for a reversible RTG -> truck -> STS loading demo. Resolve actual SOURCE box size, never guess it from yard bay parity; returns size_ft and spreader_adjustment (current size, target, required). Specify source yard bay/row and optional tier (defaults to highest visible box). Single-box loading requires an exact six-digit ship target_location, e.g. 011090. For ONE truck carrying TWO boxes, set plan_type=cumulative_double20 and provide second_source_bay/second_source_row (optional second_source_tier); destination arguments depend on delivery_mode. Planner orders sources upstream first along the work lane (-Y), preserving each source/destination pairing. Truck drives forward to each source bay: load FRONT slot first, then drive to the second bay and load REAR slot. RTG gantry must stay fixed while gripping a box; only trolley and hoist move during each pickup/placement. Empty RTG may travel between bays after unlocking/raising. No reversing in yard, including same-bay slot alignment; parking-bay reverse entry after return remains allowed. Both boxes and spreader clearance are required before leaving for STS. Preview returns loading_order and both yard_loading_stops_m. Same yard block, two 20ft sources only; the second may be below the first in the same stack. For delivery_mode=quay, require crane_id and omit BOTH ship target locations: the truck arrives with both boxes and waits for handoff, without STS motion or empty return. delivery_mode=ship (default) requires both ship target locations and STS unloads each to its user-specified ship target. Never split this request into two single-box trips or invent a source/target. Rejects buried source/target, absent 6.6 deck cells, unsupported landing, wrong size, uneven 40ft supports and unreachable STS. 20ft uses odd ship bays; 40ft uses an even bay spanning two returned odd bays. Target structural placeholders are replaced only in the demo layer, not verified vacant actual cargo slots. Returns plan_id before start.

crane_id.description: STS_01 through STS_07; specify the requested crane

function.name: start_yard_to_ship_transfer
function.description: Start a previewed yard-to-vessel loading demo by plan_id after scene-operation approval. FIRST read current RTG spreader and continuously telescope to the source box size; no descent or locking until actual geometry confirms ready. For a cumulative_double20 preview, visit the planned source bays forward, filling BOTH truck slots before leaving for STS; honor delivery_mode=quay by stopping loaded at the specified STS for handoff. Otherwise continue both individual ship deliveries. Then parked truck drives to yard; RTG locks/lifts source onto trailer; truck follows roads and causeway to selected STS; STS locks/lifts/transfers/unlocks at specified ship location. 20ft boxes load near the cab; 40ft stay centred. After unloading the empty truck returns and reverses into its original parking bay. Cinematic viewing is enabled by default unless cinematic=false. Full original box parts move continuously without rescaling. No inventory-file or PLC writes. Returns immediately; status includes rtg_spreader_size_ft, required_size_ft and spreader_ready. Poll control_yard_to_ship_transfer once and report started if still running.

function.name: control_yard_to_ship_transfer
function.description: Status, pause/resume or reset the full reverse RTG/truck/STS loading demo. Reset restores original yard box parts, target ship placeholders, truck and equipment poses. Finished tasks reserve resources until reset. Resume/reset require approval. Mutually exclusive with ship-to-yard and other equipment tasks.

function.name: preview_ship_to_yard_transfer
function.description: Read-only plan for a reversible ship-to-yard kinematic DEMO: select the TOP returned deck slot in a ship bay and side row (port=left facing bow; row_from_side=1 is the outermost port/starboard row, not rowNo01), then place on top of a rendered yard stack. Resolves 40ft support covering odd bays, checks stack height and neighbors, chooses a reachable STS and a parked truck, returns plan_id. These vessel structure slots are NOT verified actual cargo. For twin-20 set double20=true and provide BOTH user-specified target_bay/target_row and second_target_bay/second_target_row. Two adjacent odd ship bays must have same-row, same-height accessible 20ft boxes. STS grips both, RTG uses 20ft to unload each to its specified supported stack; never invent either destination. Use this before starting the complete STS/truck/RTG demonstration; do not chain the old fixed-box demos.

function.name: start_ship_to_yard_transfer
function.description: Start a previously previewed ship-to-yard visual demonstration using plan_id. Parked truck drives to STS, STS lowers/locks/lifts/transfers onto trailer, truck follows roads/causeway to yard, primary RTG locks/lifts/stacks/unlocks. 20ft boxes load near the cab; 40ft stay centred. After delivery the truck returns and reverses into its original parking bay. No teleport during carrying, PLC writes or inventory-file changes. Returns immediately; poll control_ship_to_yard_transfer status. Compact ship models normally need no normalization; permit task-only scale normalization only when explicitly authorized. Starting requires scene-operation approval.

function.name: control_transfer_camera
function.description: Control event-driven cinematic viewing for either ship-to-yard or yard-to-ship transfers: status/start/pause/resume/stop. Both starts enable it by default unless cinematic=false. Direction-specific shots follow actual pickup, truck handoff, roads/causeway and destination landing. Each entire RTG operation uses one stable work-cell camera; twin-20 unloading keeps that camera across both boxes. Phase cues update without extra cuts. Camera controls never change task execution. Manual viewing pauses the director; resume explicitly to continue. The final landing overview stays while the empty truck returns to parking; after task completion hold 3 seconds and restore the previous camera.

function.name: control_ship_to_yard_transfer
function.description: Read status, pause/resume or reset the complete ship/truck/RTG visual task. Reset restores source boxes, parked truck, crane poses and source display, without editing saved assets. A completed demonstration reserves its session poses until reset; reset before starting another demo. Resume/reset require approval.

function.name: get_vessel_structure
function.description: Query ship bay/row/tier/valid slots using the current 6.6 TXT snapshot. Use for vessel structure, deck/hold row counts or a location such as 010404. H=hold, D=deck. These are structural slots, not actual onboard cargo. Missing bays/locations are not proof of empty cargo. Raw size codes C/D/1 are undefined; bay parity gives nominal 20/40ft. include_slots enables paginated locations.

function.name: get_agent_capabilities
function.description: List all connected runtime interfaces, allowed actions, parameters and runtime requirements.

function.name: get_equipment_status
function.description: Read RTG/STS positions, motion targets, limits and stop state without moving equipment. For STS, positions.hoist is the displayed hoist coordinate, limits.hoist is [lowest, highest], and larger values raise the spreader. Read the current positions.hoist, not the previously commanded target, before choosing an upward or downward move. RTG work_mode reports TwinState workMode: 1 automatic, 2 assisted, 3 remote manual, 4 local, 5 maintenance. Check is_current/state/source; stopped/stale snapshots are not the current real device mode. Local gamepad/control ownership is separate.

crane_id.description: STS_01 through STS_07; specify the requested crane

function.name: get_current_tasks
function.description: Read current RTG, STS and IECS tasks, phases, IDs, sources, destinations, queues and snapshot time. Includes RTG work_mode even without a current task; check its freshness and source before reporting the current mode. Never starts a task.

function.name: list_viewpoints
function.description: List view presets and existing USD cameras, including camera paths for switch_viewport_camera.

function.name: set_viewport_view
function.description: Look at a port overview, RTG, trolley, spreader, bay, STS crane, yard truck, current task or specific IECS order. For 聚焦第4条任务 use target=iecs_order and order_index=4, or order_id for an exact IECS identifier. The camera tracks that order even at the gate; report the returned focus_label and vehicle_visible. Use target=task only for a generic current task. For a numbered yard truck, use target=truck with truck_number=1..20; view=chase (default) follows from outside, cabin looks forward from inside the cab, and angled shows the exterior. For looking vertically down from below the RTG trolley platform, use target=trolley, view=under_trolley. Adjust field_of_view_deg to change the lens. Changes only the viewport.

crane_id.description: STS_01 through STS_07; specify the requested crane

order_id.description: IECS order ID, for example IECS-00004

order_index.description: One-based row in the IECS workbench order list

function.name: switch_viewport_camera
function.description: Switch the active viewport to an existing USD camera path, or RTG virtual camera C01-C33 by number. Stops Agent camera following.

function.name: set_sts_axis_positions
function.description: Move a specified STS crane subject to the existing limits and boom interlock. The displayed hoist coordinate increases upward. For 抬升到10米, pass hoist_m=10 and hoist_direction=raise. For 下降到5米, pass hoist_m=5 and hoist_direction=lower. For 下降5米, pass hoist_distance_m=5 and hoist_direction=lower. Include hoist_direction whenever raising or lowering is explicitly requested; the controller rejects motion in the opposite direction. If a distance or target is missing, ask for it. Query get_equipment_status for current coordinate and limits.

crane_id.description: STS_01 through STS_07; specify the requested crane

function.name: set_rtg_spreader_size
function.description: Set the primary RTG telescopic spreader to 20 or 40 ft using the existing controller.

function.name: stop_equipment
function.description: Stop Agent RTG movement or active STS controllers. Also stops shared STS tasks to prevent their next tick restarting motion. Does not send real equipment commands.

crane_id.description: STS_01 through STS_07; specify the requested crane

function.name: resume_sts_crane
function.description: Release a specified STS crane's local stop latch. Its cancelled target is not restarted; issue a new movement command afterwards.

crane_id.description: STS_01 through STS_07; specify the requested crane

function.name: control_timeline
function.description: Read, play, pause or stop the Kit animation timeline.

function.name: control_sts_task
function.description: Start the legacy single-container unload or fixed double-20 round-trip demonstration; inspect, pause, resume, reset or focus its STS task. On the current 6.6 ship structure stage use preview_ship_to_yard_transfer(double20=true), start_ship_to_yard_transfer and control_ship_to_yard_transfer for the full twin-20 truck/RTG demonstration instead.

function.name: submit_rtg_task
function.description: Submit a LOAD, UNLOAD or SWITCH task to the existing PLC-free RTG simulator. Only simulation inventory is used. Position format is e.g. 3C55062 (bay 55, row 6, tier 2). Does not dispatch production tasks.

function.name: control_rtg_simulation
function.description: Control the RTG simulator and deterministic scenario queue. Preview/status do not start it. Scenario reset_inventory defaults to false and affects simulation stock only.

function.name: control_iecs
function.description: Use the existing integrated equipment scheduling simulator: unload/load/gate-in/gate-out/yard transfer, mixed workload, pause/resume/reset, speed, scene validation, inventory preview and task focus. Uses reversible demo layers.

order_id.description: IECS order ID, for example IECS-00004

order_index.description: One-based row in the IECS workbench order list

function.name: control_live_twin
function.description: Read status or start/stop the existing local TwinState receiver. Receives PLC/RCMS data to visualize the twin; never writes PLC commands. Stop simulation before starting a live receiver.

function.name: control_plc_zmq
function.description: Manage the local RTG ZMQ PLC simulator. start reuses a compatible existing service or launches the fixed service (command SUB 5515, state PUB 5516), then connects Kit. connect attaches only to an existing service. After start/connect completes, physics_on enables ZMQ cargo collision, landing/twistlock interlocks, gravity and stacking through sim_physics=1; it explicitly claims local control without velocity commands. Keep the timeline paused and all axes stopped. physics_off requires landing/unlocking cargo. Use physics_on for ZMQ picking/collision requests, not control_rtg_physics.activate_physics. status reports service, scene_ready, armed, physics_enabled and carried_container. stop/disconnect clear the adapter; stop only terminates an Agent-owned service. start/connect alone never arm control or stop competing drivers. Async actions return operation_id; poll completion. Never sends real PLC commands.

function.name: control_sea_motion
function.description: Read/start/stop/pause/resume sea and ship movement; set wave strength or quality; hold/release an existing moored ship.

function.name: control_camera_display
function.description: Start/stop camera displays. For a real RTSP camera such as C5, use rtsp_popup with action=start and camera_number=5. Use rtsp_popup with action=status to list configured cameras by number and location. For real RTSP spreader corners C1–C4, use spreader_rtsp_grid. RTSP opens a panel in the administrator web viewer with project-configured feeds. A started preview can still be connecting. work_views shows three docked 3D views: under-trolley top-down, side follow, and angled RTG overview. model_grid and virtual_cameras are simulated views.

function.name: control_sts_statistics
function.description: Open, query, or close 桥吊 → 数据统计 → 作业流程效率统计报表(新)-装卸船 in the administrator browser. Opening immediately displays all 今天昼夜 rows. For an explicit query, use action=query and period=today_day_night, with optional crane such as H101, or omit crane for ALL. Query also opens the report. The demo replays the captured shift (08:00 to next day 08:00 Beijing time) from a local log. Report the replay source and do not claim live or complete shift coverage. The browser displays the table; this tool returns only the summary.

function.name: analyze_sts_statistics
function.description: Analyze 桥吊装卸船效率统计报表 from replay rows and optionally open a separate analysis report. Use for 作业用时、桥吊效率对比、最慢作业、等集卡、动贝、贝扫 or 杂项时间. Returns counts, mean, median, min/max in seconds overall, by crane and by task type, and the longest rows. For 列出作业用时最长的5票, set report_view=ranking and top_n=5. A request to list or rank the longest tasks opens a ranking report even without the word 报表. Use by_crane or by_task_type for comparison reports. Use report_format=chart for 图表、柱状图 or 条形图, and choose chart_value if the question requests a particular grouped statistic. Omit report_view and report_format for chat-only answers. For multiple cranes omit crane and use by_crane. For a like-for-like comparison set task_type to LOAD or DSCH. Use the returned shift dates, valid sample counts and replay source. Block markers are recorded context, not proof of cause. The unit of observation is a task row, not a container count.

top_n.description: Number of longest rows, default 5. Use 0 for aggregates only.

report_view.description: Open a ranking or comparison panel in the administrator browser. Defaults to by_crane when only report_format is provided.

report_format.description: Choose a data table (default) or bar chart.

chart_value.description: Statistic plotted in grouped charts. Defaults to mean_seconds. Ranking charts always plot the selected timing metric.

function.name: describe_dataset
function.description: Inspect the current uploaded table, or explicitly select the built-in STS replay. Returns exact field names, SQLite types, null counts and a dataset_id for analysis.

function.name: analyze_dataset
function.description: Analyze the selected dataset using a single read-only SQLite SELECT from data. Use actual field names in square brackets, numeric measures, WHERE, GROUP BY, date functions, window functions or CTEs as needed. Alias expressions clearly. Use preview for exploration, table for details, chart for bars, line for ordered trends, and pie for 饼图 or 扇形图. For charts supply result columns x and numeric y. For pie, group by category and return nonnegative parts of a whole with a positive total; include all categories or aggregate the rest as 其他. Use counts or additive measures for a share, not averages. Check missing values, especially before aggregating text columns.

function.name: query_sts_data
function.description: Analyze the captured 桥吊装卸船 report by any supported grouping and metric. Choose group_by from the recorded columns, including crane, ship, driver, box size, lane, task type, work mode, bay and 开始小时. Choose operation=count for task counts, or mean/median/sum/min/max with a numeric measure. Use filter_field and filter_value for a substring filter such as 船名 or 箱尺寸. For requests to display a table or graph set report_format=table or chart. Return only computed values from the replay, with shift dates and sample counts. If the user requests a measure or grouping absent from the report, explain the available fields.

function.name: control_info_panel
function.description: Start/stop the existing device, container or alarm information overlay services.

function.name: show_alarm
function.description: Read, display or clear a local simulated RTG alarm. Does not acknowledge real equipment alarms.

function.name: control_gamepad
function.description: Read/start/stop existing local gamepad manual mode or position it for a named pickup slot. Does not operate real equipment.

function.name: rtg_slot_operation
function.description: Use existing inventory-backed RTG slot picking APIs: read target/alignment/calibration, move high, lower, lift, attach, detach, pick demo, calibrate, reset calibration or stop. Query bay inventory first to resolve the logical bay. Stage-only visualization.

function.name: control_rtg_physics
function.description: Inspect/validate or enable/disable the existing RTG physics/visual controller and visual sync. Physics requires Isaac/PhysX. Target commands enforce the RTG soft limits.

function.name: control_lidar
function.description: Use existing RTX LiDAR services: start/stop/status/diagnose, position markers, scan volumes/debug/wireframe, diagnostic probe or save accumulated map/scan. RTX sensing requires Isaac Sim. Output is confined to the project point-cloud directory.

function.name: capture_lidar
function.description: Start an asynchronous yard/fleet/batched/multi-position point-cloud capture. Returns an operation ID; poll get_operation_status for completion and output files. Requires initialized RTX sensors in Isaac Sim.

function.name: get_operation_status
function.description: Read background capture jobs and Agent RTG motion progress, results or errors.

function.name: cancel_operation
function.description: Cancel an Agent capture job or RTG motion by its operation ID.

function.name: reload_yard_inventory
function.description: Explicitly reload the already-selected inventory and refresh the stage. May replace current inventory visuals; does not accept arbitrary file paths.

function.name: control_livestream
function.description: Start the existing viewport-only WebRTC stream with Kit UI preserved, restore the normal UI, or enable viewport interaction. Returns the local viewer URL. Does not publish credentials.
